in_marathi.name: Ahan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ahan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ahan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'aham' which means 'I'. This name signifies radiance and shining. In Hindu mythology, Ahan is the name of the god of sun, Surya. The name is believed to bring prosperity, power, and energy to the bearer.
